question: Who should divide the structure from base to finial and into how many parts?
premises: The division spans from the base to the finial.
The total is to be divided into fifty parts.
The wise practitioner is the agent of this division.
inference: The verse instructs the knowledgeable builder to divide the whole structure from base to finial into fifty parts.
plain_english: The wise one should divide the structure from the base up to the finial into fifty parts.
